targets.quote: 1.Restoring and protecting the water cycle as basis for sustainable water supply.
targets.article: Objective 1: restore and protect the water cycle
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: 2.Building a water-smart economy together with citizens and economic actors in a way that supports EU competitiveness, is attractive to investors and supports a thriving EU water industry.
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: 3.Securing clean and affordable water and sanitation for all at all times, and empowering citizens for water resilience.
targets.article: Objective 3: clean and affordable water for all
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: the EU should aim to enhance water efficiency by at least 10% by 2030. The Commission will work with Member States and stakeholders to develop a joint methodology for water efficiency targets
targets.article: Enhance water efficiency by at least 10% by 2030
targets.label: target

targets.quote: objective to achieve good status of all water bodies by 2027
targets.article: Good status of all water bodies by 2027 (WFD)
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: Water and climate resilience must be fully integrated in the national Restoration Plans to be developed by 2026.
targets.article: Water/climate resilience in national Restoration Plans by 2026
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: goal of achieving good environmental status for marine waters by 2020 was not met.
targets.article: Good environmental status for marine waters (MSFD)
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: By June 2028, the Commission will evaluate the Water Reuse Regulation, and will subsequently consider extending its scope pending evaluation results.
targets.article: Evaluate Water Reuse Regulation by June 2028
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: Member States with water supply leakage levels exceeding the EU-wide threshold – to be set by 2028 – will have to present, by 2030, national action plans to reduce leakages across their supply networks.
targets.label: target

targets.quote: the Commission will rate their energy efficiency and overall sustainability and propose minimum performance standards, including for water consumption
targets.article: Minimum performance standards for data-centre water use
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: suggesting an annual investment gap of around EUR 23 billion per year (0.1% of EU GDP) to implement the existing water legislation
targets.article: EUR 23 billion annual water investment gap
targets.label: other

targets.quote: over EUR 15 billion in planned financing during 2025-2027 for projects enhancing access to water, pollution control, resilience and competitiveness of the EU water sector
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: The Commission will establish a Water Resilience Investment Accelerator to implement 20 pilot innovative cases for natural water retention and water efficiency
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: Develop and implement Destination Earth and EU Digital Twin of the Ocean applications for water resilience, and by 2030, make the capabilities available to national and local administrations in the EU and beyond.
targets.article: Destination Earth water capabilities available by 2030
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: Adopt a European Climate Adaptation Plan.
targets.article: Adopt a European Climate Adaptation Plan
targets.label: commitment
